endgame.label: Endgame: last uniques, recalling from depth 65
endgame.explanation: A Warrior with a Word of Recall scroll recalls from depth 65 while hunting a unique at that depth; its deepest level reached is 99 and fewer than five uniques are still alive. The branch comment says to reset the recall depth (cleaning up the last uniques for the Morgoth push). The original answers the game's "Set recall depth?" prompt with n, against its own comment; the correction answers y.
